lock_timing: After shard launch and before inspection of any future metric from the 19 new cases.
reason: The MatPhys objective uses the complete released observation prefix, including frames later called the overlay validation interval. The family score is therefore causal but not out-of-sample for the MatPhys backbone.
primary_results: raw fixed-terminal causal MatPhys versus raw released PhysTwin
fixed Bayesian-PhysTwin overlay arms reported separately without treating the overlapping prefix score as independent validation
secondary_result: The previously locked per-case family gate remains an observed-prefix adaptive policy whose one-shot future performance may be reported, but its prefix score is not evidence that the policy protects against regression.
forbidden_claim: Do not call the family score held-out, nested, independent, or validation evidence for the MatPhys backbone.
next_method_requirement: Any confirmatory family selector must use a nested prefix split, cross-case selection fixed on development objects, or an independent source cohort before final refitting on the complete observation prefix.
claim_boundary: All 22 released cases remain exploratory for this method. Independent preregistered evidence is required for a SOTA claim.
